queries.purpose: 按本轮 request_id 取拒绝事件

queries.purpose: 运行时间窗内全部拒绝事件
queries.sql: SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT request_id, occurred_at, action, category, result, http_status, http_method, route_template, permission_key, policy_decision, deny_reason, actor_type, actor_email, actor_id, organization_id, workspace_id, session_id, event_hash, trace_id, client_ip, user_agent, detail FROM audit_events_v2 WHERE action = 'authorization.denied' AND occurred_at >= '2026-09-13T05:50:58+07:00'::timestamptz AND occurred_at <= '2026-09-13T05:52:44+07:00'::timestamptz ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 500) t;
